experiment: P6 K/history online quantile repaired-dev retrospective v1
scope: one authorized retrospective evaluation on 519 recognizer-unseen dev videos; non-confirmatory; test forbidden
authorization: user reply on 2026-09-25: 授权一次 dev retrospective 评价
model: fit-only K ridge alpha100 on all 183401 rows; same feature, target, outer standardization and solver as frozen five-fold P6 script; no dev labels or outcome in fit
policy: exact frozen schedules() with paid-window self-history, current offset0, strict past-score median, unknown EOS, token initial0/accrual0.5/capacity2/no tail topup

comparators.primary: matched_uniform: evenly spaced bonus positions, exactly the quantile bonus count in each dev video
comparators.secondary: online_uniform: eager use of the same token rule
comparators.diagnostic: full_center: offset0 and offset2 in every complete block

main_outcome: paired total word-error difference quantile minus matched_uniform, divided by total reference words to report WER percentage points
uncertainty: 10000 source-cluster bootstrap draws, fixed seed 261227, percentile 95% CI; source is sample name without final numeric segment
evidence_rule: negative point difference and CI upper below zero constitute directional evidence in this dev retrospective only; otherwise report insufficient or contrary evidence without changing policy
